name: Aphrodite Fritillary
desc: Aphrodite Fritillary (Speyeria aphrodite): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 74 times near the park in GBIF.
about: The Aphrodite fritillary is a fritillary butterfly, from North America. This orange coloured fritillary has rows of dark dots or chevrons at the wing edges and black or brown lines more proximally.
